Scope: Static publisher-page, archive, version, license and behavior review of MiTeC EXE Explorer and HexEdit; no executable, analyzed file, process or disk target was opened

TermsPage.Observation: MiTeC's current support page says trial or unregistered software is freeware for non-commercial usage and describes paid user/site licensing. No local entitlement or redistribution determination is made.

Products.Name: MiTeC EXE Explorer
Products.PublishedBehavior: Reads executable formats including PE32/PE32+, NE, VxD and .NET metadata; displays headers, imports/exports, resources, certificates, version data and type libraries; can save resource types to files and produce text reports. The publisher page lists a VirusTotal scan-report feature and version history mentions a configurable user API key; exact online request/data handling is unspecified here.
Products.ArchiveMemberSet: Two executable files; no license, README or notice file found by filename.
RiskAndAcceptance: Use only synthetic, non-sensitive PE inputs; confirm viewer-only parsing and exact resource export paths before any feature acceptance.
Keep VirusTotal/API-key behavior disabled until data sent and network requests are explicitly reviewed; do not upload samples or configure a key in the source pass.

Products.Name: MiTeC HexEdit
Products.PublishedBehavior: Hex editor with file compare, memory dumper, disk dumper and data interpretation/analysis features. The page lists a paid single-user license.
Products.ArchiveMemberSet: One executable; no license, README or notice file found by filename.
RiskAndAcceptance: Any later file-edit test must use a disposable copy and exact-byte backup/restore verification.
Keep live process-memory and raw-disk features out of the default acceptance selection; require a specifically isolated target and recovery plan before testing either.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Current product-page features, version labels, explicit x86/x64 EXE Explorer files, HexEdit's x86 binary, terms page and frozen archive identities are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Local MiTeC entitlement and redistribution, VirusTotal network behavior, non-destructive resource export, HexEdit write/recovery semantics and memory/disk targeting remain unverified.
Deferred: Owner-specific MiTeC license and archive distribution assessment
EXE Explorer synthetic PE parsing/resource-export acceptance and explicit network-feature review
HexEdit file-copy edit/recovery acceptance; no live memory/disk targets
Windows target, UI and activation behavior through an approved guest workflow
MigrationDisposition.EstimateReason: Static version and feature scope is clarified, but rights and complete user-visible/runtime outcomes remain open; no estimate deduction is justified.
